## Definition of done

- [ ] All sub-issues closed and the change's tasks.md fully checked
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met and used with real content for at least two weeks (ROADMAP rule)
- [ ] Decisions documented in ADRs
- [ ] The change is archived (`/opsx:archive`) and the status table in ROADMAP.md is updated
